Reference sheet

Threadbare Gameplay Elements

Use this page while planning your StoryQuest to see some of the gameplay elements, objects, enemies, and systems that already exist in Threadbare.

You can reuse these as they are, change how they are used, combine them, or build something new. The design challenges you completed with Teleporters and the Void Enemy were only two examples of what you can build around.

Grapple

Player ability·Playable

This clip will not play in a preview window. Download the guide and open it in your browser.

Grapple · gameplay clip (no sound)

In kit scenes/dev/grapple/grapple_gym_1/grapple_gym_1.tscn ▶ Play

The player can connect to grapple points in the world.

This can include:

  • Pulling the player toward a grapple point
  • Pulling certain objects toward the player
  • Connecting to objects that have grapple points
  • Using grapple points as part of movement or puzzle challenges

Repel

Player ability · needle (sword)·Kit TBD

This clip will not play in a preview window. Download the guide and open it in your browser.

Repel · gameplay clip (no sound)

In kit res://scenes/quests/template_quests/NO_EDIT/2_NO_EDIT_combat/NO_EDIT_combat.tscn play link soon

What the player does while holding their needle (the sword). The player can push or redirect certain objects away from them, and use the needle to interact with certain objects and projectiles.

This can include:

  • Moving objects
  • Redirecting objects toward a target
  • Deflecting projectiles
  • Destroying certain objects
  • Using Repel as part of a puzzle or challenge

Combining Gameplay Elements

Putting it together

You can build a StoryQuest around one gameplay element or combine several together.

Player abilities, puzzle objects, enemies, hazards, and other systems can often interact with each other in different ways. As you plan, think about which elements support the experience you want the player to have and how they might work together.

You do not need to combine multiple systems just because they are available. Use what fits your StoryQuest.
